name: VK MCP Server
description: Runs a VK (VKontakte) community from an AI assistant: works through the community inbox and replies as the community, publishes posts, comments and stories, and reads walls, profiles and communities.

VK_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: VK community token (community → Manage → API usage → Access tokens). Posts, comments, stories and community messages act with it.

VK_SERVICE_KEY.description: Optional service key from your VK app. Reads that VK refuses the community token, such as walls, are made with it.
